values: 一名善于使用大弓的射手，能够射出穿透敌人防御的强力箭矢。
A master of the greatbow, this Marksman fires devastating arrows that punch straight through enemy defenses.
守备军格温妮丝，前来报到！
The wind's shifted. I can fire now.
辛苦了。请陪我继续战斗吧！
Good work. Stay with me in battle!
Preparing... no hair out of place... ready!
This is a surprise. Thank you.
身着铠甲立于阵前，唯有实力可以赢得尊重。
Clad in armor and standing at the front, the hero knows respect is earned through strength alone.
夏风拂过蓝绸，她以优雅守卫一切。
Her blue silk gown billows in the summer breeze as she stands guard with elegant poise.
完成主线剧情任务【剑与真王】获得。
Complete Story Quest - The Sword & The King
偶尔享受一下悠闲也不错
It's good to take a break once in a while.
希望王都的秩序一切如常
I hope order in the capital is maintained as usual.
曾有几个新兵打赌输了，被罚去帮格温妮丝搬运武器架。他们以为那把精致的长弓只是贵族小姐的装饰品，结果三个人合力才能抬起。
Some new recruits were once punished to help Gwyneth carry her weapon rack after losing a bet. To their astonishment, it took all three of them to lift her exquisite bow.
在靶场上，不用看都知道哪支箭是格温妮丝射出的。普通士兵的弓弦声是咻，而格温妮丝的弓弦声是一声如雷鸣般的爆响。
At the shooting range, it is easy to tell which arrow is Gwyneth's without even looking. While other guards' arrows hum softly through the air, hers snap with a thunderous crack.
亨德里克总想把格温妮丝调去文职，理由是守备军训练强度大。每次听到这种话，格温妮丝都不会争辩，只是默默走到训练场，当着养父的面，一箭射穿三层靶心。
Hendrik keeps trying to assign Gwyneth to a desk job, thinking the training is too intense. Each time, she simply responds by shooting a single arrow through three bullseyes before him.
女仆曾听到格温妮丝的浴室里传出低沉的声音，以为进了外人。冲进去才发现，格温妮丝正对着镜子拼命练习威严的眼神和语气。
Once, a maid heard a deep voice coming from Gwyneth's bathroom. Assuming an intruder, she burst in only to find Gwyneth rehearsing a commanding speech before the mirror.
格温妮丝在与普通士兵交谈时偶尔会纠结于用词，在命令式和随和的口吻之间犹豫不决。
When talking to her subordinates, Gwyneth sometimes finds herself unsure of the right tone, wavering between an authoritative manner and a more easygoing one.
格温妮丝看到可爱的小动物时眼睛会不自觉地发出"哇"的惊叹，然后立刻清咳一声恢复严肃表情。
At the sight of a cute animal, Gwyneth's stern expression briefly softens, her eyes subtly lighting up.
格温妮丝在写正式报告时会把字写得特别工整，连标点符号也一丝不苟。
The work reports written by Gwyneth feature meticulous handwriting, with every letter and punctuation mark perfectly placed.
在倾盆大雨的日子里，大多数士兵都会躲进营帐抱怨。只有格温妮丝会观察着雨滴，她在脑海中计算着每一滴的轨迹。
During torrential rains, most guards retreat to their tents, grumbling. Gwyneth, however, remains outside, watching the raindrops and tracing each of their paths.
在加入守备军之前，唯一能帮格温妮丝绕过亨德里克的眼线、偷偷进行训练的人，只有佩吉公主。
Before joining the Royal Guard, Gwyneth trained in secret with Princess Peggy's help to evade Hendrik's scrutiny.
市集上的抽奖摊贩最怕见到格温妮丝。她不需要作弊，那种盯着猎物般的直觉让她总能百发百中。据说她的收藏室里堆满了赢得的玩偶和稀有摆件。
The archery stall owner at the bazaar shudders at the sight of Gwyneth, for she never misses a shot. Her collection room is said to overflow with the dolls and rare trinkets she has won.
梅林阁下，请见谅，我正在整理这些孩子们送给我的玩偶，数量有些多……
Magister Merlin, sorry for the mess. I'm sorting through the toys the children sent me. There are... quite a few of them.
今日完成的工作：中央广场执勤，完成军事献演，平息猴子引起的骚乱，寻回伯爵的手袋……
Today's report: Patrolled central plaza, took part in the military parade, dealt with a monkey causing trouble, found the countess' missing handbag...
那些见风使舵的贵族……知道佩吉深受国王和王后宠爱，往日见到佩吉的时候都极尽阿谀谄媚之词。
Those nobles make me sick. Back when Peggy was in the king and queen's good graces, they'd flatter her every chance they got.
格温妮丝，你已经盯着我看了十分钟了！
Gwyneth, you've been staring at me for ten minutes!
梅林阁下，如果您没有为我想到梦境试炼的办法，我可能真的会去灰影郡……
Magister Merlin, if you hadn't suggested the dream trial, I really might have gone to Ashvale County...
这些宴会的邀请，还是推掉吧……
I should probably turn down these banquet invitations...
唔……咳咳咳！好奇怪的味道……
What is it that you're holding there?
偶尔享受一下悠闲也不错
It's good to take a break once in a while.
瑞恩小姐！我名为格温妮丝，是皇家守备军的一员。
Lady Rayne! My name is Gwyneth. I'm a member of the Royal Guard.
格温妮丝 & 爱丝特瑞达
